hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central America, bordering the Caribbean Sea, between Guatemala and Mexico || flat, swampy coastal plain; low mountains in south || only country in Central America without a coastline on the North Pacific Ocean || Resources: arable land potential, timber, fish, hydropower || Exports: raw sugar, bananas, fish, shellfish, refined petroleum (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: flat, swampy coastal plain; low mountains in south || Central America, bordering the Caribbean Sea, between Guatemala and Mexico

climate.excerpt: tropical; very hot and humid; rainy season (May to November); dry season (February to May) || frequent, devastating hurricanes (June to November) and coastal flooding (especially in south)

economy.excerpt: tourism- and agriculture-driven economy; strong post-pandemic rebound; innovative and ecological bond restructuring that significantly lowered public debt and expanded marine protections; central bank offering USD-denominated treasury notes; high mobility across borders || Exports: raw sugar, bananas, fish, shellfish, refined petroleum (2023) || Industries: garment production, food processing, tourism, construction, oil
